public_domain_references.asv: and if any man shall take away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God shall take away his part from the tree of life, and out of the holy city, which are written in this book.
public_domain_references.kjv: And if any man shall take away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God shall take away his part out of the book of life, and out of the holy city, and [from] the things which are written in this book.

pob.text: The one who testifies to these things says[a], “Yes, I am coming soon.” Amen. Come, Lord Jesus.

spob.text: The one who gives this testimony says,[a] “Yes, I am coming soon.” Amen. Come, Lord Jesus.

public_domain_references.bsb: He who testifies to these things says, “Yes, I am coming soon.” Amen. Come, Lord Jesus!
public_domain_references.web: He who testifies these things says, “Yes, I am coming soon.” Amen! Yes, come, Lord Jesus!
public_domain_references.asv: He who testifieth these things saith, Yea: I come quickly. Amen: come, Lord Jesus.
public_domain_references.kjv: He which testifieth these things saith, Surely I come quickly. Amen. Even so, come, Lord Jesus.

pob.text: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with all[a].

spob.text: May the grace of the Lord Jesus be with all.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with all the saints. Amen.
public_domain_references.web: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with all the saints. Amen.
public_domain_references.asv: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with the saints. Amen.
public_domain_references.kjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ [be] with you all. Amen.
